sloka: विस्मय व्यग्र मनसो बभूवुः वानरर्षभाः ।संजात परिशंकाः ते तत् बिलम् प्लवग उत्तमाः ॥४-५०-११॥
transliteration: vismaya vyagra manaso babhūvuḥ vānararṣabhāḥ ।saṁjāta pariśaṁkāḥ te tat bilam plavaga uttamāḥ ॥4-50-11॥

translations.english: The brilliant host of monkeys experienced both fear and joy to see the cave difficult to enter.
